outline: The contents of this course include the first law of thermodynamics (energy analysis), the second law of thermodynamics (entropy analysis), exergy analysis (a combined first- and second-law analysis), power cycles, and refrigeration cycles.
schedule:
1. Introduction and Basic Concepts
2. Energy, Energy Transfer, and General Energy Analysis
3. Thermodynamic Properties
4. Energy Analysis of Closed Systems
5. Energy Analysis of Closed Systems
6. Mass and Energy Analysis of Control Volumes
7. Mass and Energy Analysis of Control Volumes
8. The Second Law of Thermodynamics
9. Midterm Exam
10. Entropy Analysis
11. Entropy Analysis
12. Entropy Analysis
13. Exergy Analysis
14. Exergy Analysis
15. Exergy Analysis
16. Power Cycles
17. Refrigeration Cycles
18. Final Exam
